lines.text: Since God in His mercy gave them this ministry, Paul and his companions do not lose heart and renounce secret and shameful ways.
The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers so they cannot see the light of the gospel.
Paul proclaims Moses as Lord, and says God made His light shine in their hearts.
Paul says they are hard pressed but not crushed, persecuted but not forsaken, and struck down but not destroyed.
Paul knows the One who raised the Lord Jesus will raise them, and their affliction produces an eternal crown of righteousness.
